title: Maximum number of supported packet filters

entities.name: Maximum number of supported packet filters
entities.description: Information element indicating the maximum number of packet filters a UE can support for a PDU session.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification
entities.description: Procedure where the UE requests modification of PDU session parameters.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Condition where UE moves from S1 mode to N1 mode in single-registration mode with N26 interface support.

entities.name: PDU session type condition
entities.description: Condition where PDU session type is IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, or Ethernet.

entities.name: UE supports more than 16 packet filters
entities.description: Condition where UE can support more than 16 packet filters for the PDU session.

entities.name: No previous successful PDU session modification
entities.description: Condition where UE has not previously successfully performed UE-requested PDU session modification to provide this capability.

relations.description: IE inclusion is guarded by inter-system change condition.
IE inclusion is guarded by PDU session type condition.
IE inclusion is guarded by UE packet filter support condition.
IE inclusion is guarded by condition of no previous successful PDU session modification.
